definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines null for a pointer and an object reference; GR1 b) uses the pointer sense, 'the predefined address NULL', which §2002:8.4.2.10.3 GR1 defines for a data-pointer exactly as 2023 does. The governed operands (data-pointers) are unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Arm c) does rest on §2002:14.5.12.1.3: EC-STORAGE-NOT-ALLOC is NF (§2002:14.5.12.1.5), so unchecked 'processing proceeds as indicated for the statement' and checked runs the USE declarative and then continues; 14.5.12.1.2 (fatal) and 14.5.12.2 do not reach it.
